Subject: Request: deep-dive demo + procurement checklist

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the intro earlier this week. We're close to an internal decision and would like a technical deep-dive with AE + SE before we sign. Can you do a 90-minute session that covers:
- architecture and VPC/private deployment options
- throughput/latency profiling for 10 req/s steady state
- data handling and audit log behavior for SOC2

Preferred windows: Mon 6/14 afternoon ET or Tue 6/15 morning ET.

Procurement will need an updated SOW and a network diagram to validate firewall rules ahead of any private deployment. I've attached a short procurement checklist (see attachment stub).

Thanks,
Liam

Options:
1) Move the demo to Wed 6/16 when Marissa is back (cleanest for tech deep-dive).
2) Keep the 6/14 slot and have Avery Johnson run the technical session as the backup SE. I've worked with Avery on private deployments before; she'll need the demo agenda and the network diagram to prepare.

If Nova is comfortable with a backup SE, I propose we keep Mon 6/14 2:00–3:30 PM and I loop Avery in. If procurement needs to review SOW/network first, we can shift to 6/16 and have Marissa lead.

I've attached the latest demo agenda (draft) to this thread.

Hi all,

Heads up — we surfaced a production incident this morning affecting a downstream service. Our ops team has asked us to freeze any vendor integrations and procurement activity until they triage; procurement has therefore asked to push the technical deep-dive out by a week to give them time to validate network changes.

Also, procurement explicitly requested a network diagram and the SOW draft before they commit to a demo slot. We need that material to run the internal sign-off.

Could you pause scheduling for now and send the SOW_draft_v1.pdf + Network_Diagram.png when you have them? We will re-open scheduling next week once ops greenlights.

Apologies for the churn — we'll confirm as soon as we can.

Thanks,
Liam
